question: Choose the word or phrase that is the antonym of **How much**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. How little**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"How much"** is used to refer to the quantity or amount of something (कितना).
 
 
• **Example:** How much water do you drink every day?
 
 
• The word **"How little"** is the antonym of "How much," and it is used to refer to a smaller quantity or amount (कितना कम).
 
 
• **Example:** You wouldn't believe how little time it took to finish this project.
